claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The bill permits supervised pre-test driving practice outside driving school.
claim_reviews.reason: Outcome accepted, but evidence locator must be new StVG § 2e, not § 2d. The proposal requires authorisation and implementing safeguards.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: MOVING estimates a shortage exceeding 10,000 driving instructors.
claim_reviews.reason: Independently downloadedMOVING 2025p3 confirms10,926 as survey/extrapolation (N400), supporting the attributed estimate without making it an officialOctober 2026 count.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Germany has about 35,000 active driving instructors.
claim_reviews.reason: IndependentMOVING 2024pp9–10 distinguishes licence holders, age-cutoff scenarios and about32,000 estimated active.35,000 current active remains unmatched.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The active instructor workforce averages about 55 years of age.
claim_reviews.reason: The55-year figure derives from a licence-holder forecast rather than a matched active-workforce observed mean. Do not infer a false approximate mean.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The share reporting class-B costs below €2,500 fell from 48% to 21% across earlier and recent acquisition cohorts in the 2023 ADAC survey.
claim_reviews.reason: Visually inspected original 2023 cost chart:48% and21% refer to3–4-year versus≤6-month tenure groups. Approximately halved is fair.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The €3,500–4,500 cost band grew from 10% to 22% in the same survey cohort comparison.
claim_reviews.reason: Original cost graphic displays10% and22% in the€3,500–4,500 band. Survey cohorts and rounding retained.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The transport ministry gives average class-B licence costs of about €3,400.
claim_reviews.reason: Official reform package and ministry context corroborate the approximate€3,400 attribution; no new market mean is inferred.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: In the 2023 survey, 59% completed training within seven months.
claim_reviews.reason: Original release says nearly60% needed more than6 months. Without full duration distribution, this does not refute59% within7 months; intervals may overlap.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: 75% needed at most 30 ordinary driving lessons plus 12 special lessons before passing.
claim_reviews.reason: Original ADAC graphic explicitly headlines three quarters, shows42%+32% and warns of rounding differences, with12 mandatoryspeciallessons excluded. Incontext75% reasonably reports the publisher’s rounded three quarters; exact unrounded count is not needed to treat the approximate source figure as supported.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: If any mandatory in-person theory remains, savings in ongoing driving-school premises costs are impossible at that point.
claim_reviews.reason: Retained premises may retain some fixed costs but no evidence makes every room-related saving impossible; sharing, cost mix and capacity matter.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Passing the theory examination demonstrates fulfilment of all theory-training requirements and a comparable starting point across learning formats.
claim_reviews.reason: FeV § 16 examines knowledge; educational goals extend to attitudes and behaviour. A common pass threshold is not proof of full learning-format equivalence.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Ordinary German class-B learner instruction is currently tied to authorised driving schools.
claim_reviews.reason: Ordinary German first acquisition is school/instructor tied, with training readiness attestation. Statutory exceptions andBF17 after passing remain distinct.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: France, Austria and Switzerland allow conditional pre-test practice with lay companions, with school attendance only partly obligatory or absent.
claim_reviews.reason: Independent Swiss federalindexedArt15 and cantonal police guidance confirm conditional private learner drives; school attendance is not universally absent because other required courses differ. The narrow pretest-practice possibility is supported across named examples; clarify the stronger school-exemption clause rather than retain only a retrieval-gap rationale.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Foreign accompanied-driving curricula provide up to 3,000 km of parental pre-test practice.
claim_reviews.reason: AustrianL17 and French AAC use at least3,000km, not a maximum. Colloquial scale reading of up to remains fair; no error solely from that phrase.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: German learners average 500–700 km of practice by the test.
claim_reviews.reason: No matched representative current Germany mileage dataset established; law’s lesson minima do not imply national mean distance.

evidence_checks.locator: Annex7 does not provide mileage mean
evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: BF17 increases total practice before first unaccompanied driving to about 2,000 km.
claim_reviews.reason: About2,000km is plausible illustration from older500+1,400 figures, but no current distribution or maximum is verified.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Currently around 25% obtain their licence before age 18, compared with over 40% twelve years earlier.
claim_reviews.reason: The denominator/time window for25% versus>40% remains unspecified. Full12-month BF17 use is not the same as any licence before 18.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Average experience at the start of unaccompanied driving has significantly fallen, caused by longer training duration.
claim_reviews.reason: Neither cross-sectional 2023survey nor historical evaluation identifies longer training as the cause of a nationwide later-mileage decline.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Additional insurance costs of pre-test lay practice would also arise in BF17 and are effectively brought forward rather than newly created.
claim_reviews.reason: Insurance price equivalence depends on actual coverage, drivers and policies; no matched before/after quote supports universal brought-forward-only costs.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Foreign experience shows accident risk does not rise when training-process requirements are removed.
claim_reviews.reason: Positive accompanied practice evaluation cannot establish no risk from removing unspecified training requirements across countries. Reforms and cohorts differ.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: BF17 evaluation shows that more protected practice produces a larger later safety benefit.
claim_reviews.reason: Newly accessed primary 2007 evaluation reports a duration gradient:>6 months versus≤6 months accompanied phase had57% lower registered at-fault accident probability in18 months. This supports the contextual evaluation-based claim; duration is a practice proxy and the nonrandom cohort comparison does not prove a universal mileage dose law or benefit of arbitrary requirement removal.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Austrian experience suggests fewer than half initially choose lay practice outside school.
claim_reviews.reason: CurrentAustrianL17 share below half does not establish initial uptake of all lay-practice pathways; keep unresolved and not a falsehood.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Driving schools currently provide expert initial advice, accompany training and coordinate examination preparation.
claim_reviews.reason: Training and readiness duties substantiate core coordination; universal counselling practice/authority cost saving is a stronger empirical claim and remains unquantified.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Current FeV §21 requires the application to name the training school.
claim_reviews.reason: Own downloaded FeV dated12 August 2026 retains named training school in § 21(1).

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The bill records municipal-association concerns about authority burdens from changed school binding.
claim_reviews.reason: Primary NKR opinion does record municipal burden concerns and€30 versus€19.20 fees, but for the supervised practice pilot. It does not expressly attribute that concern to removing school binding; the broader paragraph may reference the package context. Retain uncertainty but replace complete access-gap rationale with this precise causal-scope distinction.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: FeV §18(1) ordinarily requires at least two weeks before repeating a failed test.
claim_reviews.reason: Own FeV § 18(1) confirms ordinarily at least 2 weeks; special cheating rules separate.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Theory instruction aims to develop responsible behaviour, self-assessment, hazard awareness and consideration as well as rule knowledge.
claim_reviews.reason: Training aims include responsibility, self-assessment, hazard awareness and consideration; this verifies the aim rather than actual attainment.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Special instruction covers rural/interurban, motorway and night driving.
claim_reviews.reason: Special driving categories are rural/motorway/darkness; no quantified marginal effect is inferred.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Removing fixed special-lesson minima alone does not establish a general reduction in practical training costs because individual competence still determines required training.
claim_reviews.reason: Removing minimum quantity alone does not determine actual competence-required quantity or price; safe logical premise rather than an outcome forecast.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Pass rates also depend on learner characteristics, language, anxiety and interruptions rather than school quality alone.
claim_reviews.reason: General composition caution is defensible, but every named empirical factor is not separately identified by the cited regulation. Keep full compound outcome unresolved.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Individual service prices do not determine the eventual total cost without the learner’s quantities and service mix.
claim_reviews.reason: Unit prices without quantities do not determine learner-specific total; does not imply price information is useless.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: The proposed transparency register requires collection, maintenance and checking of data.
claim_reviews.reason: Draft requires collection, updating and register-management functions; net cost and portal effects remain forecasts.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reviewed_claim_en: Finland introduced stricter age-exception criteria and night driving restrictions for 17-year-olds in 2026.
claim_reviews.reason: Independently downloaded Traficom confirms stricter exception criteria and midnight–05:00 ban effective29 May 2026.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.

claim_reviews.reason: Independently downloaded11 June/23 June notice confirms8→12 hours from 1 October 2026, keyed to driving test date.

evidence_checks.check: Independently accessed/read; actualproposition andtemporal scope compared.
